proposed.text: Which of the following areas is EXCLUDED from the calculation of Gross Floor Area (GFA) under the 2004 Revised IRR of PD 1096?

options.text: Covered parking areas provided to satisfy minimum parking requirements
All corridors, lobbies, and toilets within the building envelope, as they are essential for circulation and services
Enclosed mezzanines, which are considered part of the usable floor space
All covered balconies and terraces, which contribute to the building's aesthetic and functional outdoor space

Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: The GFA exclusion for required parking is a key policy rationale for podium-type developments in the Philippines. By excluding parking from the floor area limit, the code incentivizes adequate parking provision without penalizing the developer through reduced allowable GFA. This is a common exam topic and a practical design consideration.
